raw:
@q query
  select ?l
  where all
    match
      relation "return"
      role subject ?p
      role object ?l
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "leave"
      role subject ?p
      role time ?t
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "be in Q3"
      role subject ?t
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "be wiped"
      role subject ?l
      polarity negated
    end
  end
